quote: My unit took part in a Battlefield Study of Monte Cassino in June 2014. I can, without reservation, say that the services of Frank de Planta made our study a real success. Frank has a real passion for the subject and the ability to put complex facts and figures across in a way that is easily understood by all. As the organiser, I found his advice in the planning stages very helpful and his local knowledge was second to none. I would unreservedly recommend Frank’s services, indeed my unit have already booked for next year!
name: Capt David Hayles
